findings.text: non-blocking: _discard_run_store_row deletes from runs/run_details directly and never moves the run_signatures mirror, so after any refused landing the mirror keeps a present=1 row; _signature_counts_agree then fails forever and every cold signature read falls back to _legacy_run_signature, which reads every payload again, defeating this node's cost goal for that project until a forced rebuild. Routing the discard through RunStore.delete_run would keep the mirror in step.
non-blocking: the evidence quotes the negative-control failure as 210,452,555 bytes, but negative-control.log records 210452554, so the fragment's quotation does not match the log it cites.

non-blocking: _retire_signature's INSERT fallback writes project as the caller's empty default string when no mirror row exists, so a deletion or archive of an unmirrored row leaves a tombstone that a project-filtered incremental read never sees; the fallback should carry the row's real project.

item_verdicts.call_sites: production call sites reaching the change are reckon/ledger.py:1852 stored_history, reckon/ledger.py:1950 picker_runs and reckon/budget.py:715.
item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit from 5ac9f1d1df7a to c7589c1719: the fix adds the run_signatures mirror and sequence cursor to run_store.py and the delta read to ledger.py, the test adds four cases, and the two docs commits only add the evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_a_store_signature_reads_no_payloads.py and its four cases measure both reads in bytes, the rows each statement returned, payload doubling within 10 percent, and value equality against the base query; manifest and after_suite log record the run.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is a change signature that reads a payload-free mirror instead of the store's payloads; reckon/run_store.py:1328 stored_run_signature now answers from run_signatures and ledger.py:1892 passes a version cursor.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records all four cases passing, the scoped gate (62 passed), both suite arms with their revisions and EXIT lines, and the all_debug live-store probe numbers.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/run_store.py, reckon/ledger.py, the new test and the evidence fragment, and all four diff paths fall inside that list.

justifications.durability: the negative control at 5ac9f1d1df7a fails on the byte bound (EXIT=1, 210452554 bytes), so reverting the mirror reddens the suite, but the tombstone-on-incremental-delete path has no assertion of its own.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_a_store_signature_reads_no_payloads.py measures both reads with /proc/self/io and the statement counters, and the after_suite log at c22bc47ad3 records 62 passed in 67.18s ending EXIT=0, though the evidence fragment at line 75 misquotes the negative-control byte figure.
justifications.fit: the added symbols follow the module's existing declaration-plus-comment idiom and ruff check is clean on every changed file.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/run_store.py:1328 now answers from the payload-free run_signatures table and its version cursor (stored_run_signature's since branch at reckon/run_store.py:1394), so the signature no longer reads payloads as the goal requires.
justifications.reuse: no existing owner of a payload-free signature mirror exists in reckon/ (a capability search over run_store.py, metadata_index.py and file_memo.py found none), but the added delete_run at reckon/run_store.py:2683 does not replace the direct DELETE in reckon/crew/promotion_scope.py:2769.
justifications.scope_discipline: all four changed paths (reckon/run_store.py, reckon/ledger.py, the new test and the evidence fragment) are inside the node's declared write paths, and the declared figures directory is simply unused.
